crossRefs.note: and be ready for the third day; for on the third day Yahweh will come down in the sight of all the people on Mount…
On the third day, when it was morning, there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud on the mountain, and the…
He said, “Yahweh came from Sinai, and rose from Seir to them. He shone from Mount Paran. He came from the ten thousands…
Oh that you would tear the heavens, that you would come down, that the mountains might quake at your presence.
When you did awesome things which we didn’t look for, you came down, and the mountains quaked at your presence.
God came from Teman, the Holy One from Mount Paran. His glory covered the heavens, and his praise filled the earth.
God spoke all these words, saying,
Yahweh said to Moses, “This is what you shall tell the children of Israel: ‘You yourselves have seen that I have talked…
the day that you stood before Yahweh your God in Horeb, when Yahweh said to me, “Assemble the people to me, and I will…
Did a people ever hear the voice of God speaking out of the middle of the fire, as you have heard, and live?
Yahweh spoke with you face to face on the mountain out of the middle of the fire,
Yahweh spoke these words to all your assembly on the mountain out of the middle of the fire, of the cloud, and of the…
For you have not come to a mountain that might be touched, and that burned with fire, and to blackness, darkness, storm,
What great nation is there that has statutes and ordinances so righteous as all this law which I set before you today?
Now, Israel, what does Yahweh your God require of you, but to fear Yahweh your God, to walk in all his ways, to love…
to keep Yahweh’s commandments and statutes, which I command you today for your good?
Yahweh’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. Yahweh’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple.
Therefore I love your commandments more than gold, yes, more than pure gold.
Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way.
I gave them my statutes, and showed them my ordinances, which if a man does, he will live in them.
Therefore the law indeed is holy, and the commandment holy, and righteous, and good.
But if what I don’t desire, that I do, I consent to the law that it is good.
All of your words are truth. Every one of your righteous ordinances endures forever.

people.name: Sinai
people.line: Mountain where Moses received the Ten Commandments

translations.web: “You also came down on Mount Sinai, and spoke with them from heaven, and gave them right ordinances and true laws, good statutes and commandments,
translations.bsb: You came down on Mount Sinai and spoke with them from heaven. You gave them just ordinances, true laws, and good statutes and commandments.
translations.kjv: Thou camest down also upon mount Sinai, and spakest with them from heaven, and gavest them right judgments, and true laws, good statutes and commandments:
